summary: Quantitative risk and model-governance professional with ~7 years across market and balance-sheet risk, derivatives valuation, and independent model review, aligned to an Associate Director, Global Risk Analytics mandate. Holds delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs for multi-asset institutional portfolios ($5–25bn per engagement; $50bn+ cumulative) at Moody’s Analytics, reviewing pricing and scenario outputs across rates, FX, and inflation. Strong in Python, MATLAB, SQL, stochastic and Monte Carlo simulation, and statistics, with applied knowledge of Basel-aligned market-risk and stress-testing frameworks. CFA charterholder, dual MSc.

experience.employer: Moody’s Analytics – Asset Management & Buy-Side Solutions

sections.heading: Valuation, Model Review & Risk Oversight
bullets: Hold delegated sign-off authority for valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs across multi-asset institutional portfolios ($5–25bn per engagement; $50bn+ cumulative), independently reviewing curve construction, spread calibration, and cross-asset interactions before release.

Independently review and validate derivatives pricing and sensitivity outputs across rates, FX, and inflation, ensuring sensitivities and scenario impacts are consistent at portfolio-level aggregates.
Review aggregation logic converting security-level exposures into portfolio-level risk metrics feeding downstream ALM and capital processes.
Oversee interest-rate risk and duration analysis under parallel and non-parallel rate-shock scenarios, aligned with IRRBB and Basel Committee frameworks.
Document model assumptions, limitations, and testing results to support internal validation and approval, consistent with model-governance documentation standards.

sections.heading: Scenario, Stress & Liquidity Analytics
bullets: Lead the design and ongoing development of an enterprise multi-asset cash flow projection and scenario engine (base, stress, reverse-stress), applicable to CCAR-style forward-looking stress assessment.
Architect configurable time-bucketed liquidity gap analytics (T+1 through multi-year) supporting funding, refinancing, and capital-adequacy assessment.
Develop tools to monitor model performance, assumptions, and limitations on an ongoing basis, investigating and remediating issues surfaced through monitoring or independent validation.
Re-engineer manual spreadsheet workflows into auditable Python pipelines and build agentic AI workflows (Claude Code, Cursor IDE) that cut development and validation cycle time ~30–40%.

sections.heading: Governance & Stakeholder Communication
bullets: Operate within a formal model-governance framework, reviewing assumptions and stress methodologies and escalating outputs lacking mathematical or economic defensibility.
Explain complex modelling concepts and scenario impacts to senior management and clients’ Heads of Risk, translating quantitative outputs into decision-ready narratives.

roles.title: Client Service Specialist – ALM & Risk Analytics

bullets: Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms migrating to the PFaroe analytics platform.
Served as technical liaison between client investment teams and product owners, translating requirements into development requests and validating model outputs post-deployment.
Contributed to the successful migration of all assigned client accounts from the legacy Calypso platform to the PFaroe PM platform.

roles.title: Senior Consultant – IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients, aligning regulatory requirements with model and system implementation.
Advised actuarial, finance, IT, and risk functions; contributed to governance documentation and regulatory-readiness processes for financial institutions.
Delivered ALM studies for pension funds and institutional investors, analyzing funding ratios, duration mismatch, and long-term balance-sheet risk exposures.
Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators (Monte Carlo) to assess interest-rate risk and funding volatility under base-case and stressed environments.
Conducted liability-driven investment (LDI) analysis, evaluating trade-offs between return objectives, duration alignment, and liquidity considerations.
Presented findings to investment committees and senior stakeholders to support strategic allocation decisions.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) – Western University, 2016
